description: The fold stage of a card head: from the measured widths of the head, its padding, its leading button, the gap between its elements, its tools, its ⋯ button, its tabs and the gap between them and the width of the tools that a folded head keeps beside ⋯, the fullscreen toggle and the leader mark (keptWidth), and the chrome metrics tab-peek-w (peek), tab-min-w (minTab) and tab-grab-w (grab), the stage of the tabs (strip: every tab, one: the active tab, ham: no tab) and of the tools (bar, menu: the ⋯ menu with the kept tools beside it, or all: the ⋯ menu alone), which takes the widest tab in place of the active tab, so it is the same whichever tab is active (docs/spec/example-model.md#card-tabs).
